name: flow
description: Generic agentic workflow loop for Claude Code — /plan → /execute → /verify → /validate → /done, plus /onboard, /status, /pause, /resume, /ddr, /retro, /scenario, /bug-fix, /quick, /code-review. Project-agnostic via `<project>` placeholder + per-repo `.ai/workflows.config.json`. Bundled subagents (a11y-auditor, design-system-guard, scenario-runner, test-coverage) and skills (workflow-state, ddr-keeper, scenario, agent-browser, agent-device, codebase-intelligence, a11y-checker, question-protocol, make-skill-template).
